credentials.heading: Credentials
credentials.description: Elysium tries active credentials in priority order, lowest number first. Tokens are encrypted and never shown again after saving. A signed-in Claude account is kept signed in by Elysium, which also shows its usage.

agentConfiguration.heading: Agent configuration
agentConfiguration.description: Every agent turn runs Claude Code with the configuration in this repository: its CLAUDE.md, skills, and settings. Elysium fetches it when the API starts and whenever this changes. A github.com repository is read with the default GitHub token.
agentConfiguration.repositoryHint: An https git URL without credentials. Leave blank to use Claude Code's defaults.
agentConfiguration.loadError: The agent configuration could not be loaded.

setup.title: Get the token
setup.description: Check off each step as you go.

chatgpt-oauth.login: Sign in with your ChatGPT account. A browser window opens.
chatgpt-oauth.open: Open the credentials file Codex wrote. On Windows it is in your user folder under .codex.
chatgpt-oauth.copy: Copy the whole file into Secret token.

claude-code-oauth.signIn: Sign in with your Claude subscription in the browser window that opens.
claude-code-oauth.copy: Copy the token the terminal prints. It starts with sk-ant-oat01-.
claude-code-oauth.expiry: The token lasts one year. Use One year from now to set the expiry.

claude-api-token.open: Open API keys in the Anthropic Console.
claude-api-token.create: Choose Create key and give it a name.
claude-api-token.copy: Copy the key. It starts with sk-ant-api03- and is shown only once.

chatgpt-api-token.open: Open API keys on the OpenAI platform.
chatgpt-api-token.create: Choose Create new secret key and pick a project.
chatgpt-api-token.copy: Copy the key. It starts with sk- and is shown only once.
chatgpt-api-token.billing: Make sure the organization has billing set up, or requests fail.

claude-account.start: Choose Start sign-in. Elysium starts the Claude Code CLI in its workspace.
claude-account.open: Open Claude's sign-in page and sign in with your Claude subscription.
claude-account.code: Copy the code the page shows and paste it into Code.
claude-account.kept: Elysium refreshes the account from then on. Sign in again only if it shows Sign-in expired.

signIn.description: Elysium signs in with the official Claude Code CLI and keeps the account signed in itself, refreshing it before it lapses. Start the sign-in, open Claude's page, sign in there, and paste the code it shows.
signIn.nameHint: Optional. Leave blank to name it after the account's email.
signIn.codeHint: Paste the code Claude's page shows after you sign in.
